integrity: Proof supplied with exact arithmetic finite verifier. Finite checks are not an infinite proof; the primary motivating supplementary materials were not fully available, and independent audit has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: Connected, simple, loopless, undirected, unweighted graph; expected-payoff donation game; individual replacement probabilities rather than only aggregated strategy transitions; universal equality for all binary configurations and all positive benefits/costs; strictly positive selection. Does not cover alternative update rules, weighted or directed graphs, or only fixation-probability equality.
title: Complete-bipartite classification of invisible social comparison in death–birth games
